bend.limits: Local X bends into XZ about Y; radius>0 and radius+Z>0; caller constrains angle to avoid overlaps. STEP mesh fixture is faceted, not an exact deformed NURBS claim.

twist.limits: Rotation about local Z by rate*Z; geometry may self-intersect for excessive deformation. Mesh STEP is faceted.

taper.limits: Local XY scale=1+rate*Z; strictly positive scale required; mesh STEP is faceted.

sweep_path.limits: 2..32 stations; convex origin-containing CCW profile with 3..31 corners; discrete parallel transport, no antiparallel tangents. Exact piecewise bilinear GPU net exported to CAD; not a certified continuous RMF solver.

loft_chordal.limits: 2..11 compatible nonrational sections; centroid chord parameters, natural cubic C2 interpolation. Coincident adjacent centroids rejected.

catmull_clark.limits: One step on closed consistently oriented manifold quads, <=128 vertices/faces, <=256 edges; fresh destination; boundary/crease rules are separate operations.

loop_subdivide.limits: One original Loop step, closed consistently oriented manifold triangles; <=128 vertices, <=256 triangles, <=384 edges; fresh destination.

resample_grid.limits: Bilinear sampling of a 2..32 by 2..32 source grid; output within bounded mesh capacity; preserves bilinear geometry, no curvature reconstruction.

resample_polyline.limits: Uniform accumulated chord distance, 2..128 finite input points, 2..4096 outputs; zero-length adjacent segments rejected.
